name: POS Tools exposes Default vs Fastest checkout flow
description: Open POS tools and verify the Sell flow setting offers Default and Fastest options under Checkout.

planSteps.description: Go to /pos/ccef8d1c-72c2-44e8-b61c-6a016656cfd3 (sign in with configured manager account if needed; staff Sara PIN 1234 / open shift if prompted)
Open POS Tools (wrench / tools control in the POS header)
Under Checkout / Sell flow, both Default and Fastest radio options are visible (or Amharic ነባሪ / በጣም ፈጣን). Pass if either language is shown.
